channel.title: AUTOHOT — China Auto Industry News
channel.description: Daily news from China's auto industry: new car launches, sales data and industry buzz.

item.title: New price war hits: BMW X6 M discounted by up to ¥380,000 nationwide
item.description:
• The BMW X6 M is discounted by up to ¥380,000 nationwide, a 25.9% cut, with a starting price of ¥1,088,900.
  • The BMW X6 M sold just 3 units nationwide last month, with a consumer rating of 4.39.
  • Rival Porsche Cayenne sold 1,358 units last month. Prices are indicative; check local dealers.

item.title: Voyah delivers 13,189 vehicles in July; Passion S launches August 15
item.description:
• Voyah delivered 13,189 vehicles in July and 89,453 units January–July, up 31% year over year.
  • The Voyah Passion S topped 10,000 pre-orders within one hour and launches August 15 in Chengdu.
  • The Voyah Dreamer leads the ¥300,000–¥700,000 MPV segment; the Dreamer 9 targets the ¥500,000 flagship market.

item.title: XPeng delivers 38,027 vehicles in July, passing 1.2M cumulative deliveries globally
item.description:
• XPeng Group delivered 38,027 vehicles in July, up about 4% year over year.
  • As of July, XPeng's cumulative global deliveries surpassed 1.2 million units.
  • XPeng now operates in 65 countries and regions, and plans to launch five models in Australia in H2 2026.

item.title: NIO delivers 35,934 vehicles in July; cumulative deliveries reach 1,224,649
item.description:
• NIO delivered 35,934 vehicles in July, up 71.0% year over year.
  • By brand: NIO 20,008 units, Onvo 10,155 units and Firefly 5,771 units in July.
  • Deliveries totaled 227,057 units in the first seven months, an all-time high, for 1,224,649 cumulative.

item.title: Zeekr delivers 35,837 vehicles in July; global users pass 850,000
item.description:
• Zeekr delivered 35,837 vehicles in July, up 111% year over year and a monthly record.
  • Zeekr's cumulative global user base surpassed 850,000.
  • The Zeekr 9X enters the Middle East as a full-vehicle export in H2; Mansory has ordered 200 units for a bespoke edition.

item.title: HIMA delivers 45,046 vehicles in July; cumulative deliveries reach 1.48M
item.description:
• HIMA delivered 45,046 vehicles in July and 286,000 units January–July, up 13.7% year over year.
  • Cumulative deliveries across all series passed 1.48 million units, with the AITO M9 alone above 300,000.
  • The Maextro V800 and V680 launch August 5, with Luxeed G9 pre-orders opening the same day.

item.title: AION Y Plus Black & White Warrior Edition launches at a flat ¥89,800
item.description:
• GAC Aion launched the AION Y Plus Black & White Warrior Edition on August 1 at a flat price of ¥89,800.
  • That is ¥10,000 below the previous entry trim, a new low for the series.
  • The commemorative edition keeps the core specification, emphasizing value and personalization for younger buyers.

item.title: Leapmotor delivers 101,267 vehicles globally in July, topping 100,000 in a month for the first time
item.description:
• Leapmotor delivered 101,267 vehicles globally in July, up 102% year over year and past 100,000 for the first time.
  • The B01 and B10 launched July 16; the A10 completed hot-weather testing and the A05 opened blind pre-orders.
  • Leapmotor completed Mexican localization certification and began deliveries, with a limited-time August campaign.

item.title: FAW-Volkswagen first in industry to offer dual lifetime warranty across the range
item.description:
• From August 1, FAW-Volkswagen offers a dual lifetime warranty to new buyers of all ICE and PHEV models.
  • Coverage includes the complete vehicle and original parts, with no time or mileage limit and nationwide service.
  • Previously limited to ICE SUVs, the benefit now extends to sedans and PHEV models.

item.title: Li Auto delivers 30,468 vehicles in July; cumulative deliveries reach 1,764,155
item.description:
• Li Auto delivered 30,468 vehicles in July, for 1,764,155 cumulative deliveries.
  • The next-generation Li L6 launched, and deliveries are set to pass 400,000 units in August.
  • The Li L9 launched in Kazakhstan with local production; cumulative deliveries exceed 300,000 units.

item.title: Xiaomi delivers over 30,000 vehicles in July; Pengcheng series expected in September
item.description:
• Xiaomi Auto delivered more than 30,000 vehicles in July.
  • The Pengcheng series is expected to launch in September, when pricing and trims will be announced.
  • Pre-order prices: Pengcheng N70 Max at ¥259,900 and N90 Max at ¥299,900.

item.title: Wuling Yangguang Pro launches from ¥94,800, nearly 5.5m long with up to 405km range
item.description:
• The Wuling Yangguang Pro launched in five trims priced ¥94,800–¥138,800 with member benefits.
  • It is an all-electric light van measuring 5,495mm long with 318–405km of CLTC range.
  • Two-, six- and nine-seat layouts are offered, with 30%–80% charging in 20 minutes.

item.title: Hongguang MINIEV turns six as Wuling city-car users approach 3 million
item.description:
• SAIC-GM-Wuling says its city-car user base will pass 3 million, with a sixth-anniversary event on August 7.
  • The Hongguang MINIEV family has sold over 1.95 million units, leading China's A00 EV segment for 71 straight months.
  • The fifth-generation Hongguang MINIEV launched in Indonesia at about ¥59,600, with a Toy Story 5 tie-in.

item.title: Entering the EREV race: Xiaomi opens pre-orders for two Pengcheng SUV Max variants
item.description:
• Xiaomi unveiled its Kunlun technology architecture and the Pengcheng series, opening pre-orders for two extended-range SUVs.
  • The Pengcheng N70 Max is priced at ¥259,900 and the N90 Max at ¥299,900 in pre-order.
  • Launch and deliveries are expected in September; the N90 Max offers 1,705km of combined range.

item.title: FREELANDER 8 enters volume production; pre-orders open August 10
item.description:
• The FREELANDER 8, developed by Chery with Jaguar Land Rover, rolled off the line and opens pre-orders August 10.
  • It is positioned as a luxury all-terrain SUV at 5,118mm long with a 3,040mm wheelbase and six seats.
  • An 800V platform is standard, with 310km of CLTC electric range and Huawei Qiankun ADS 5.

item.title: MG 07 opens pre-orders in the ¥125,900–¥168,900 range
item.description:
• The MG 07 opened pre-orders across five trims at ¥125,900–¥168,900.
  • The all-electric coupe sedan offers 650km and 845km range versions.
  • Selected trims add LiDAR, mCDC magnetorheological suspension and an 800V high-voltage platform.

item.title: Denza Z9S pre-orders open August 3 with second-generation Blade battery and flash charging
item.description:
• The Denza Z9S opens pre-orders on August 3, positioned as a tech-luxury intelligent sedan.
  • It carries the second-generation Blade battery, flash charging, the e-Three-Way platform and DiSus-A suspension.
  • Range is expected above 1,000km, with five minutes of charging adding nine minutes of driving and supercar-level acceleration.

item.title: Zeekr 9X five-seat version launches at a limited-time ¥451,900
item.description:
• The Zeekr 9X five-seater launched in three trims at limited-time prices of ¥451,900 to ¥565,900.
  • It features four core technologies including the Haohan super hybrid, with up to 1.4m of second-row legroom.
  • A full-stack 900V architecture delivers 0–100 km/h in as little as 3.1 seconds and 20%–80% charging in nine minutes.

item.title: From ¥988,000, limited to 9 units in China: new Lotus Emira Scura launches
item.description:
• The Lotus Emira Scura limited edition launched from ¥988,000, capped at nine units in China.
  • It uses a 2.0T four-cylinder engine producing 405 hp, with 0–100 km/h in 4.3 seconds.
  • Sport suspension and Michelin Cup 2 tires are standard, with exclusive matte paint and red interior.

item.title: 2026 Lorinser Gulfstream four-seater launches from ¥1,688,000 with 50-inch IMAX partition screen
item.description:
• The 2026 Lorinser Gulfstream four-seater launched in two versions at ¥1,688,000 and ¥1,988,000.
  • It features a 50-inch IMAX partition screen, shell-style enveloping aviation seats and four seat posture modes.
  • The body is reshaped around aerodynamics, with a biomimetic scale-pattern intelligent cooling grille and a powered rising hood ornament.

item.title: Priced ¥109,900–¥129,900: Chery Fulwin A9 officially launches
item.description:
• The Chery Fulwin A9 officially launched at ¥109,900–¥129,900.
  • It is a mid-to-large all-electric coupe sedan with up to 655km of CLTC range.
  • A 70kWh battery is standard across the range, with a peak motor output of 178kW.

item.title: BYD Dynasty delivers its 10,000th Tang EV
item.description:
• BYD Dynasty held a handover ceremony for the 10,000th Tang EV in Koktokay, Xinjiang, unveiling a flash-charging corridor.
  • The Tang EV passed 10,000 deliveries within a month of launch with over 150,000 orders; the new Han D+ flagship sedan debuted with 1,008km of range…
  • BYD plans to build 20,000 flash-charging stations by the end of 2026, already covering four…

item.title: bZ7 announces full battery liability policy, no penalty for existing owners
item.description:
• GAC Toyota announced a policy accepting full manufacturer liability for battery fire incidents, covering new and existing bZ7 and bZ3X owners.
  • The bZ7 offers a lifetime warranty on the three electric systems, a battery designed to last over 20 years and free cell replacement for faults after eight years.
  • The bZ7 will receive OTA updates adding sentinel and escort modes; bZ series sales passed 50,000 units in the first half.

item.title: Han EV offers 1,008km of electric range, debuting at the Chengdu auto show
item.description:
• The BYD Han EV offers 1,008km of range and will appear at the Chengdu auto show in August.
  • It measures 5,256mm long with a 3,130mm wheelbase, positioned as a full-size D+ segment sedan.
  • Flash charging fills the battery in five minutes, with dual-motor AWD and single-motor RWD versions.

item.title: An AI all-terrain hardcore SUV: Geely Galaxy Zhanjian 700 makes its debut
item.description:
• Geely's Galaxy Zhanjian 700 made its global debut in Hangzhou as a mid-to-large plug-in hybrid hardcore SUV measuring 5,085/1,999/1,912…
  • It uses a tri-motor AWD setup with differential locks for 830kW combined output, an AI all-terrain system and 233mm of ground clearance…
  • The Galaxy Zhanjian 700 arrives in Milan, Italy on July 26, alongside…

item.title: Voyah Passion S opens pre-orders at ¥309,900
item.description:
• The Voyah Passion S opened pre-orders at ¥309,900, with dual zero-gravity seats among the launch benefits.
  • It carries Huawei Qiankun ADS 5 with four LiDAR units, HarmonyOS Cockpit 5.2, a 98kWh battery and an 800V platform.
  • Positioned as a tech FUV, it is over 5m long with a 3m wheelbase, front double-wishbone and rear five-link suspension plus EDC magic-carpet damping…

item.title: Priced at ¥359,800: Subaru Outback Wilderness launches with Q3 deliveries
item.description:
• The Subaru Outback Wilderness launched through parallel import at ¥359,800, with deliveries expected by the end of Q3…
  • It uses a 2.4T turbocharged boxer engine producing 194kW and 375 N·m, paired with CVT and full-time AWD…
  • Exterior and interior add off-road kit and exclusive badging, with a 12.1-inch…

item.title: Limited-time member price from ¥165,800: Dongfeng eπ M8 launches
item.description:
• The Dongfeng eπ M8 launched in five versions from a limited-time member price of ¥165,800.
  • It offers both extended-range and all-electric powertrains, with 600km CLTC range for the EV and 1,281km combined for the EREV.
  • Huawei Qiankun ADS 5 Pro and HarmonyOS Cockpit are standard, and it holds 12 CATARC certifications.

item.title: Limited-time ¥145,800–¥196,800: Lynk & Co 07 GT officially launches
item.description:
• The Lynk & Co 07 GT launched in four trims listed at ¥157,800–¥208,800, with limited-time pricing of ¥145,800–¥196,800.
  • The mid-size plug-in hybrid shooting brake offers over 200km of electric range, up to 1,422km combined, and 0–100 km/h in 5.5 seconds for AWD.
  • LiDAR is standard across the range, running Flyme Auto 2.…

item.title: Mecha styling! Limited-time ¥449,800: FAW Toyota Land Cruiser Prado WALD edition launches
item.description:
• The FAW Toyota Land Cruiser Prado WALD edition launched at a list price of ¥499,800 and a limited-time price of ¥449,800.
  • Mecha-style body kit extends length by 170mm to 5,085mm, on a 2,850mm wheelbase.
  • It uses a 2.4T hybrid system with 330 hp combined and 630 N·m, paired with an 8AT.

item.title: BYD Qin MAX interior and exterior revealed, positioned as a mid-size sedan
item.description:
• BYD revealed the Qin MAX as a mid-size sedan measuring 4,866×1,880×1,495mm on a 2,820mm wheelbase.
  • Exterior colors include Cloud Pink, with a Dawn Purple interior and a new two-spoke steering wheel.
  • Launch is expected in the second half, with flash charging, God's Eye B and DiSus-C on board.

item.title: Subaru Crosstrek Boxer 60th Anniversary edition launches from ¥215,800, limited to 25 units
item.description:
• The Subaru Crosstrek Boxer 60th Anniversary edition launched in two trims at ¥215,800–¥230,800, limited to 25 units.
  • Based on the current Crosstrek 2.5i AWD Luxury and Flagship trims, it adds a 4WILD kit and commemorative decals at no extra cost.
  • Power comes from a 2.5L naturally aspirated engine producing 169 hp,…

item.title: All-new styling and a longer wheelbase: new GAC Trumpchi GS4 launches July 24
item.description:
• The all-new GAC Trumpchi GS4 launches July 24 as a five-seat compact SUV.
  • The wheelbase grows 20mm to 2,770mm, paired with a 1.5T engine.
  • Peak output is 130kW and 270 N·m, matched to a seven-speed wet dual-clutch transmission.

item.title: 2027 Trumpchi Xiangwang S7 PHEV launches July 22 with upgraded 192-line LiDAR
item.description:
• The 2027 Trumpchi Xiangwang S7 PHEV launches July 22 with an upgraded 192-line LiDAR.
  • A 38.8kWh battery pack delivers 1,200km of combined range, with electric range improved over the current car.
  • The 1.5T plug-in hybrid system carries over in front- and all-wheel-drive versions rated 288kW and 368kW.

item.title: Chery Fulwin A9 launches July 25 from ¥115,900, an all-electric mid-to-large coupe sedan
item.description:
• The Chery Fulwin A9 launches July 25 with pre-order pricing of ¥115,900–¥135,900.
  • The all-electric mid-to-large coupe sedan offers 655km of CLTC range and 178kW from its single motor.
  • LiDAR is fitted, supporting urban and highway NOA, with 30%–80% charging in 20 minutes.

item.title: Lynk & Co 07 GT, Geely Galaxy TT Ultra and more: 2026 week 30 (Jul 20–26) new car preview
item.description:
• The Geely Galaxy TT Ultra opens pre-orders July 21 with dual-motor AWD, 0–100 km/h in 3.8 seconds and 650km of CLTC range.
  • The Lynk & Co 07 GT is pre-priced at ¥165,800–¥185,800, with a limited edition at ¥208,800, in front- and all-wheel drive.
  • The Dongfeng eπ M8 is pre-priced from ¥199,800 in all-electric and extended-range versions, with EV range…

item.title: Priced at ¥182,800 with 1,580km combined range: Hongqi HS6 PHEV 152 Zhixiang launches
item.description:
• The Hongqi HS6 PHEV 152 Zhixiang edition launched at ¥182,800.
  • CLTC electric range is 152km, with 1,580km of combined range.
  • Buyers receive deposit credits, complimentary insurance and other benefits.

item.title: Pre-priced from ¥199,800 with six Huawei systems standard: Dongfeng eπ M8 launches July 23
item.description:
• The Dongfeng eπ M8 launches July 23 with pre-order pricing from ¥199,800.
  • Huawei's Qiankun six-piece intelligent suite is standard across the range, in extended-range and all-electric versions.
  • The EV offers 600km of range and the EREV 300km of electric range, positioned as a mid-to-large six-seat SUV.

item.title: Priced at ¥329,800: second-generation Denza D9 PHEV flash-charge Luxury lowers the entry point
item.description:
• The second-generation Denza D9 PHEV flash-charge Luxury launched at ¥329,800 as the new entry trim.
  • It pairs a 1.5T plug-in hybrid AWD system with a 58.5kWh Blade battery for 350km of CLTC electric range and 148… combined.
  • God's Eye B LiDAR is standard, while the HUD and passenger display are dropped to lower the price.

item.title: From ¥199,800 after limited-time benefits, with a new infotainment chip: 2026 Nissan Pathfinder launches
item.description:
• The 2026 Nissan Pathfinder launched in two trims listed at ¥219,800 and ¥249,800, with limited-time prices of ¥199,800 and ¥22…
  • It switches to a Qualcomm Snapdragon 8155 chip with AI large-model voice control and NISSAN OS, adding two-tone paint and 20-inch…
  • Power comes from the 2.0T VC-TURBO engine with peak…

item.title: BMW 7 Series Yiying Collector's Edition launches at ¥1,218,000, limited to 700 units worldwide
item.description:
• The BMW 7 Series Yiying Collector's Edition launched at ¥1,218,000, limited to 700 units worldwide.
  • Exclusive frozen black and frozen dark grey paints are offered, with truffle leather and a 31.3-inch rear screen.
  • A 3.0T engine with 48V mild hybrid produces 280kW, with 0–100 km/h in 5.4 seconds.

item.title: A ¥5,000 deposit unlocks up to ¥90,000 in benefits: Zeekr 9X five-seater launches July 28
item.description:
• The Zeekr 9X five-seater launches July 28, with a ¥5,000 deposit unlocking up to ¥90,000 in benefits.
  • A 2.0T super hybrid system delivers 1,030kW combined and 0–100 km/h in 3.1 seconds.
  • It carries 43 sensors, with over 1,400 TOPS of compute on the H9 trim supporting L3 autonomy.

item.title: Priced at ¥222,500: FAW-Volkswagen Tayron L 380TSI 35th Anniversary Selection launches
item.description:
• The FAW-Volkswagen Tayron L 380TSI 35th Anniversary Selection launched at ¥222,500.
  • Equipment is streamlined, dropping matrix headlights and rear independent climate control to lower the price.
  • A 2.0T engine produces 162kW, paired with a seven-speed wet dual-clutch transmission.

item.title: Pre-priced from ¥165,800! Lynk & Co 07 GT launches July 23!
item.description:
• The Lynk & Co 07 GT launches July 23, pre-priced at ¥165,800–¥185,800 with a time-limited edition at ¥208,800.
  • Front- and all-wheel-drive versions offer 200km/170km of electric range and 1,422km/1,315km combined.
  • LiDAR is standard across the range, running LYNK Flyme Auto 2…

item.title: Awaiting pricing, with a 1.5T plug-in hybrid: WEY V9X Family Edition launches July 16
item.description:
• The WEY V9X Family Edition launches July 16 with a 1.5T plug-in hybrid, expected to serve as the new entry trim.
  • The current V9X lineup spans three trims at ¥349,800–¥389,800, all using the 2.0T Hi4 plug-in hybrid system.
  • Current models offer multiple size and range options, with 310–470km of CLTC electric range,…

item.title: Priced at ¥259,800: Ford Edge L AWD five-seat Comfort launches with a five-seat layout
item.description:
• The Ford Edge L adds a 2.0T AWD five-seat Comfort trim at ¥259,800.
  • It adopts a five-seat layout with a 12.3-inch instrument cluster and 13.2-inch center screen.
  • A 2.0T engine produces 252 hp, paired with an eight-speed automatic and all-wheel drive.

item.title: 2,820mm wheelbase with PHEV and EV options: BYD Qin MAX teaser released
item.description:
• BYD released Qin MAX teasers, positioning it as a mid-size sedan on a 2,820mm wheelbase, longer than the Qin L.
  • Plug-in hybrid and all-electric versions are offered; the PHEV pairs a 1.5L engine with a motor, while the EV offers 530km/630km of range.
  • It carries the second-generation Blade battery and flash charging, with 10%–70% fast charging in five minutes.

item.title: Dongfeng Nissan NX8 EREV 260 Pro launches at a limited-time ¥159,900 with 260km of electric range
item.description:
• The Dongfeng Nissan NX8 EREV 260 Pro launched at ¥169,900, with a limited-time trade-in price of ¥159,900.
  • CLTC electric range is 260km with 1,400km combined, using a 1.5T range extender and a 195kW motor.
  • Limited-time pricing across the range is ¥149,900–¥199,900, or as low as ¥135,000 after national subsidies…

item.title: NIO ES8 five-seater from ¥274,800 with battery rental, dual reclining rear seats and a huge trunk
item.description:
• The NIO ES8 five-seater launched at ¥382,800–¥422,800, or ¥274,800–¥314,800 under the BaaS battery rental scheme…
  • Trunk capacity is 1,334L, expanding to 3,084L with seats folded, and the rear row gets dual reclining seats.
  • A 900V architecture delivers 520kW combined and 655km of CLTC range, with July 1…

item.title: Pre-priced from ¥117,800, an all-new mid-to-large PHEV SUV: Wuling Starlight L launches July 16
item.description:
• The Wuling Starlight L launches July 16, pre-priced at ¥122,800–¥142,800 with member pricing of ¥117,800–¥137,800…
  • It is a mid-to-large plug-in hybrid SUV with 1,260km of CLTC combined range and 260km of electric range.
  • A 1.5L plug-in hybrid system is standard, with a 170kW peak motor output and 0–100 km/…
